verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents that a triggered run's handle can be used to retry it, and the run page records a trace view with logs. Together these give a thin, first-party basis for manually rerunning a failed run and inspecting its history. Automatic retries with exponential backoff are a different capability and are not credited as replay. Missing for 10: documented replay of a failed run from its recorded history (payload/state), the ability to resume or rerun from a specific step, dashboard or CLI replay workflow details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I replay or rerun a failed workflow from its recorded history — optionally from a specific step — to debug and recover

citations.quote: You can use the handle to check the status of the task, cancel and retry it.
the run page will show a trace view of each task executing in real-time along with any logs it produces.
